import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Fraud vs Non-Fraud by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], loc='upper right')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Transaction amount distribution for fraud vs non-fraud
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
non_fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
ax2.hist([non_fraud_amounts, fraud_amounts], bins=30, label=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Fraud rate by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({'is_fraud': ['sum', 'count']})
hourly_fraud.columns = ['fraud_count', 'total_count']
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['fraud_count'] / hourly_fraud['total_count'] * 100)
ax3.plot(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=6, color='#e74c3c', markeredgecolor='black', markeredgewidth=0.5)
ax3.fill_between(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Box plot of transaction amounts by transaction type and fraud status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Non-Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label', 
            palette={'Non-Fraud': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.legend(title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
